name: Bench on the kitchen side, VIHALS, BESTÅ sideboard on the far wall
notes:
Bench on the kitchen side: a low, backless ÅLHULT bench along the open side keeps the view to the kitchen clear at 17 3/4" high, and no chair ever slides back into the walkway. The clearance it saves lets a full-depth BESTÅ sideboard with drawers take the far (right) wall. Set for six as placed with the table closed: the bench (2), three VIHALS and Maddie's URBAN. Nothing stands in the 30" walkway (F-42).
Flags: tight:35.9 (F-36, both table ends); tight:24.1 (F-36, the ends with the leaf in); tight:19.8 (F-32, the sideboard's drawers to the seated right-hand chairs' backs; 38.25" with those chairs tucked in); assumed-position:door; anchor-required (storage-1, F-21).
bench-1 ÅLHULT bench (ikea-60603093), rot 270 at x 30, y 39.25: its back edge on the walkway's edge, centered on the table; you step over it from the walkway, and it slides under the table when not in use (its page: 'The bench can be tucked away under the table').
table-1 VIHALS extendable, white (ikea-20589777), rot 90 at x 44.125, y 35.875, against the bench: F-36 44.1" from its kitchen-side edge to the kitchen line (passing, 42-48" met; the bench needs no pull-out room), 38.25" from its right edge to the sideboard, 35.9" to the top and bottom walls (tight:35.9); leaf in, 24.1" at the ends (tight:24.1).
chair-3, chair-4 VIHALS (ikea-50569103), right side at the quarter points: 19.75" behind them to the sideboard while seated. chair-5 VIHALS, bottom end: 17.4" behind it.
junior-chair-1 URBAN (ikea-00165213), top end: 17" behind it.
storage-1 BESTÅ storage combination with drawers, white stained oak effect (ikea-39412689), right wall centered (y 24.1 to 94.9): F-36 38.25" from the table; F-32 19.75" from the drawer fronts to a seated chair's back (tight:19.8), 38.25" with the chairs tucked in; push-open, no knobs; anchor-required (F-21: 29 1/8").
art-1 BLODFLÄDER (ikea-20601915), top layer, centered above the sideboard; lamp-1, lamp-2 VARPTROSS (ikea-20610854), top layer, flanking it, centers about 58" up, plug-in.
pendant-1 GULLSUDARE (ikea-90603869), top layer over the table's center (58.7, 59.5) on the HAVSRIS swag cord, 5.3" left of the room's center.
plant-1 FEJKA bird of paradise (ikea-70610601), floor, bottom-right corner, clear of every chair.
rug-1 LYDERSHOLM (ikea-50495409), rug layer from the walkway's edge (x 30 to 109, y 0.5 to 118.5): under the bench and the table, 35.75" past the table's right edge and 35.4" past each end, so every chair stays on it; 2.5" short of the sideboard; the walkway stays bare tile.
Extras: HAVSRIS x 1; STOPP FILT x 2; runner x 1; placemats x 6; BLANDA MATT x 1; MALINDA chair pads x 3.
Not placed: chairs on the kitchen side (the bench replaces them). No window is drawn, so no window treatments (F-41). The kitchen line is unmeasured (wall, counter or open floor): the clearances treat it as the edge of a 30" walkway that stays clear (F-42). Prices: items captured today as of 2026-10-23; reused catalog items as of 2026-10-22 are price-stale (F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces read on 2026-10-23. Not in the catalog, so not summed: light bulbs (E26 LED for the pendant, E12 LED for each VARPTROSS).
